verdict.rationale: The pack has no training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment from Omnara. Self-hosting (Apache 2.0), bring-your-own model keys and self-hosted models are adjacent deployment options that a user could arrange, not a documented control preventing data from being used for training. The GitHub note about building training datasets from self-hosted Postgres describes the operator's own use of agent history, not a protection against training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
